// Command gamelink-agent exposes specifically approved game ports through
// Tailcat. It is administered only through this local command line; it has no
// network management interface.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime/debug"
	"strings"

	"github.com/gamelink-project/gamelink/internal/rustcore"
)

var version = "0.1.0-alpha"

const usage = `gamelink-agent - expose approved game ports through Tailcat (no router port forwarding)

Usage:
  gamelink-agent [--dir DIR] <command> [options]

Setup:
  init                          create the agent configuration directory
  games add                     expose a game port (generates the game's own Tailcat identity)
  games list                    list configured games
  games remove <id>             stop exposing a game and delete its identity

Access control (per game; a game with no approved devices is unreachable):
  devices approve               approve a friend's public key for one game
  devices revoke                revoke a device (a running agent restarts that game and ends the session)
  devices list                  list approved devices

Sharing and running:
  invite                        print the invitation a friend imports into GameLink (a secret)
  serve                         run the agent in the foreground (Ctrl-C / SIGTERM to stop)
  status                        show games, approvals and whether the agent is running
  version                       print the version

The configuration directory defaults to $GAMELINK_AGENT_DIR, else
<user config dir>/gamelink-agent. Run 'gamelink-agent <command> -h' for options.
`

func main() {
	os.Exit(run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr))
}

// run is main without the process exit, so the CLI is testable.
func run(args []string, stdin io.Reader, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {
	dir := os.Getenv("GAMELINK_AGENT_DIR")
	// Optional leading --dir DIR.
	for len(args) >= 1 && (args[0] == "--dir" || args[0] == "-dir" || strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "--dir=")) {
		if v, ok := strings.CutPrefix(args[0], "--dir="); ok {
			dir, args = v, args[1:]
		} else if len(args) >= 2 {
			dir, args = args[1], args[2:]
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintln(stderr, "error: --dir needs a value")
			return 2
		}
	}
	if len(args) == 0 || args[0] == "-h" || args[0] == "--help" || args[0] == "help" {
		fmt.Fprint(stdout, usage)
		return 0
	}
	if dir == "" {
		base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(stderr, "error: cannot determine a configuration directory; set GAMELINK_AGENT_DIR or pass --dir")
			return 2
		}
		dir = filepath.Join(base, "gamelink-agent")
	}
	c := &cli{dir: dir, in: stdin, out: stdout, err: stderr}
	cmd, rest := args[0], args[1:]
	var err error
	switch cmd {
	case "version", "--version":
		// Exercise the linked Rust core even for a diagnostic-only invocation.
		out, coreErr := rustcore.Call("version", nil)
		var coreVersion struct {
			ABI int `json:"abi"`
		}
		if coreErr != nil || json.Unmarshal(out, &coreVersion) != nil || coreVersion.ABI != 1 {
			fmt.Fprintln(stderr, "error: incompatible or unavailable Rust core")
			return 1
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(stdout, "gamelink-agent %s%s\n", version, buildInfo())
		return 0
	case "init":
		err = c.cmdInit(rest)
	case "games":
		err = c.cmdGames(rest)
	case "devices":
		err = c.cmdDevices(rest)
	case "invite":
		err = c.cmdInvite(rest)
	case "serve":
		err = c.cmdServe(rest)
	case "status":
		err = c.cmdStatus(rest)
	default:
		fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "unknown command %q\n\n%s", cmd, usage)
		return 2
	}
	if err != nil {
		if err == errUsage {
			return 2
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "error: %v\n", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func buildInfo() string {
	if bi, ok := debug.ReadBuildInfo(); ok {
		for _, s := range bi.Settings {
			if s.Key == "vcs.revision" && len(s.Value) >= 8 {
				return " (" + s.Value[:8] + ")"
			}
		}
	}
	return ""
}
